title: 2027 Seoul Marathon — official race outline (97th Dong-A Marathon)
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: The English official site lists the 2027 event as the 97th Dong-A Marathon.
The 2027 race date is Sunday, 21 March 2027.
The Full Marathon gathers at Gwanghwamun Square and the 10 km at the Jamsil Sports Complex; both are marked scheduled (tentative) on the outline.
Registration opens on Tuesday 1 September 2026 at 10:00 KST; places are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis by payment order.
The race is presented as a World Athletics Platinum Label road race and a World Athletics Heritage Site competition.
On the 2027 English site the course map, race schedule and pack pickup pages are still marked TBD.
